name: Into the Mainframe
author: iiJason124
description: Release from the hold early at 30.8% to touch the size portal but not the ball portal and stay as the wave. Navigate through the gameplay as the wave until 33% where you can hold above the level shortly before the gamemode and 4x speed portal. Maintain a position above the gameplay offscreen until 66% where you need to fall back into the screen, spam through the gameplay as the wave and then enter the ship portal at 72%. Play the rest of the level normally from there.
